content: If parameter FrIf_CtrlIdx of FrIf_CancelAbsoluteTimer has an in- valid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect equals ON), the function FrIf_CancelAbsoluteTimer shall report development error code FRIF_E_INV_CTRL_IDX to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.
